title: Pure Fusion
summary: The Pure 'Fusion' / Polymerization archetype focuses on cards that search, recycle, and weaponize 'Polymerization' and 'Fusion' Spells—led by King of the Swamp, Keeper of Dragon Magic, Fusion Recycling Plant, and Fusion Duplication. By substituting for named materials with King of the Swamp and recycling Polymerization every turn via Fusion Recycling Plant, the deck effortlessly chains together Guardian Chimera, Millennium-Eyes Restrict, and Magnum the Reliever.

allow.Keeper of Dragon Magic: Normal/Special Summon starter that discards 1 card to search any 'Polymerization' Normal Spell or 'Fusion' Normal Spell directly from the Deck.
allow.Beastking of the Swamps: Level 4 WATER Aqua Fusion Substitute monster that can substitute for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster.
allow.Goddess with the Third Eye: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Fusion Substitute monster that substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material.
allow.Magnum the Reliever: Level 8 Fusion boss (1 monster Summoned from the Extra Deck + 1 monster in the hand) that recycles a 'Polymerization' or 'Fusion' Spell from your GY to draw 1 card, and banishes a Polymerization/Fusion Spell from GY as a Quick Effect to destroy a card on the field!
allow.Guardian Chimera: Level 9 Fusion boss summoned via Polymerization or Fusion Duplication that draws cards and destroys cards on the opponent's field.
allow.Millennium-Eyes Restrict: Level 1 Fusion summoned via Instant Fusion or King of the Swamp that absorbs opposing monsters when they activate effects and negates them.
allow.Thousand-Eyes Restrict: Classic Level 1 Fusion summoned via Instant Fusion or King of the Swamp that absorbs an opponent's monster.
allow.Mudragon of the Swamp: Level 4 Fusion summoned via Super Polymerization that protects your monsters of the declared Attribute from targeting.
allow.Garura, Wings of Resonant Life: Level 6 Fusion summoned via Super Polymerization using 2 monsters with the same Type and Attribute that draws 1 card when sent to the GY.

main: King of the Swamp
Core Fusion engine: substitutes for ANY 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, OR discards itself from the hand to add 1 'Polymerization' from your Deck to your hand.
Keeper of Dragon Magic
Core starter: discards 1 card on Normal or Special Summon to add ANY 'Polymerization' Normal Spell or 'Fusion' Normal Spell from your Deck to your hand.
Beastking of the Swamps
Substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material and pairs with King of the Swamp for WATER/Aqua synergies.
Goddess with the Third Eye
Substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material and provides a LIGHT Fairy body for Magnum the Reliever and Guardian Chimera.
Polymerization
The iconic original Fusion Spell, searchable by King of the Swamp, Keeper of Dragon Magic, Fusion Sage, and Fusion Recycling Plant.
Ultra Polymerization
Pays 2000 LP to Fusion Summon using 2 monsters you control with neither player able to respond, then banishes itself from GY to revive both Fusion Materials!
Super Polymerization
Unrespondable Quick-Play Fusion Spell that fuses your opponent's monsters into Mudragon of the Swamp or Garura, Wings of Resonant Life.
Instant Fusion
Limited to 1 in TCG: pays 1000 LP to Special Summon Millennium-Eyes Restrict or Thousand-Eyes Restrict directly from the Extra Deck.
Fusion Recycling Plant
Field Spell that discards 1 card to add Polymerization from your Deck or GY to your hand, and recovers 1 Fusion Material from your GY during the End Phase.
Fusion Sage
Adds 1 Polymerization from your Deck to your hand.
Fusion Reserve
Normal Trap that reveals a Fusion Monster in the Extra Deck to add 1 listed material (or King of the Swamp) and recover Polymerization from your GY.
Fusion Duplication
Normal Trap that banishes 1 'Fusion' or 'Polymerization' Normal/Quick-Play Spell from either GY and applies its Fusion Summon effect during the opponent's turn!
extra: Signature Fusion boss for the Polymerization engine: returns 1 'Polymerization' or 'Fusion' Spell from your GY to the bottom of the Deck to draw 1 card, and banishes 1 Polymerization/Fusion Spell from your GY as a Quick Effect to destroy 1 card on the field!
Level 9 Fusion boss (3 monsters with different names) that draws cards equal to hand materials and destroys cards equal to field materials, and is untargetable while Polymerization is in your GY!
Summoned using King of the Swamp + 1 Effect Monster (or Instant Fusion) to absorb and negate opposing monsters when they activate effects.
Summoned via King of the Swamp or Instant Fusion to absorb an opponent's monster.
Super Polymerization target that prevents your opponent from targeting monsters of a declared Attribute.
Super Polymerization target that inflicts double battle damage and draws 1 card when sent to the GY.
